purpose: Correct the released Lean CPU key-frequency repetition order to match the author's CUDA branch, and measure its effect on the automatic PolypGen combined system.
bug: When k_repeat>1, the released _repeat_freqs_for_k CPU branch interleaves frequency rows, whereas its CUDA branch repeats the complete frequency grid. The fixed CPU helper concatenates complete grids and leaves repeat=1 and non-CPU behavior unchanged. The author checkout is not modified.
method: Replay the same first automatic YOLO box, original earlier-FPN points and automatic mask, Lean 25% spatial retention, pooled-grid anchor score, frame schedule, FP32 runtime and checkpoint. Only the CPU key-frequency repeat helper changes. Existing native and Lean historical runs are not rerun. No re-detection, new confidence gate or new threshold is introduced.
verification: Unit tests verify complex grids, multiple repeat counts and restoration on error. Two independently run unmodified seq3 video replays must exactly reproduce the archived masks and token-selection receipts. Two independently run fixed seq3 gates must reproduce all masks, selections and frequency traces, preserve the original prompt and model parameters, match the original masks before the first affected call, and prove the corrected helper matches the CUDA-branch expression. No labels are used during inference. Full video runs require both baseline replays and both fixed gates; an independent scorer must verify every saved output against labels and source hashes.
metrics: Report all-frame present Dice and empty-frame false alarms; also historical-target-frame Dice and per-sequence differences against the identical-prompt original combined system. Compare to the better native/Lean historical score only as a GT-prompt retrospective reference, not as an inference-time selector. Report sequence-level uncertainty descriptively and unchanged model/token budgets.
limitations: This fixes only CPU repetition ordering; it does not establish that rotary frequencies after top-k pruning match the original retained spatial indices, and it does not remove the query-grid fallback. Fixing the helper changes downstream attention, selected tokens, predictions, memory and routing. Previous CPU scores describe the released uncorrected behavior and should not be treated as the corrected system. PolypGen was previously inspected, annotations may be incomplete, and the detector training split is unknown.
